rules.catch_all_scope: the whole line that carries the miner's name and its count
rules.digest: sha256("<bounty id>|<hunter address, lower case>|<rule>|<block number>|<salt>") in lower-case hex

pay_condition.M1: the pinned mining page shows one named miner with more than half of at least min_blocks blocks
pay_condition.P1: a block from 0 to 100 on the pinned block page creates coins for someone beyond the ordinary block reward

rules.queue: filings rank by the network's creation time of their transaction, then by the order of processing
